claim_text: He describes what he says the Lord tells him about while he sits and listens: the finances, the president, what is coming after the attack on Venezuela, and what is coming for China and Taiwan.
quote: what's coming after the attack with uh Venezuela and what's happening next
falsify_match: Nothing to match. He names subject areas rather than events, so no outcome would confirm this.
falsify_miss: Nothing to miss either. This is a description of his practice, not a claim about the world, and it is listed here only because the passage names three countries.

claim_text: He teaches on hearing precisely from the commander in chief and distributing the message, saying the Lord told him there is a difference between generals, lieutenants and privates, and that he is instructed on what he will and will not do.
quote: there's a lot of difference between generals and privates and lieutenants
falsify_match: No event is named, so nothing could confirm it.
falsify_miss: An analogy about rank in prayer. It carries no prediction and would be scored as teaching rather than a word.

claim_text: A square cement tomb with a door, buried under the sand by the pyramids, is uncovered, with a voice saying this is by Jerusalem; things in Israel and in Italy will be uncovered, and a major earthquake is about to take place.
quote: I saw there's a major earthquake about to take place
falsify_match: An excavation near the Giza pyramids of a square built tomb with a door, announced in the months after 5 January 2026, together with a major earthquake in Italy.
falsify_miss: Egyptian excavations are announced several times a year and Italy has damaging quakes on a regular cycle, so both halves have a high base rate. Nothing here dates the earthquake or names a magnitude, and no depth or site is given for the tomb.

claim_text: Women of Middle Eastern descent are seen weeping before the Lord throughout Iran and throughout Africa, and a major harvest of souls is coming in which he says God will use his listeners.
quote: a major harvest of souls is coming
falsify_match: Reported mass conversions in Iran and across Africa on a scale beyond the existing trend, in the year after January 2026.
falsify_miss: Church growth in Africa and underground church growth in Iran are both long-running and widely reported already, so almost any report would be read as a match. No number, no date and no named place makes this unfalsifiable in practice.

claim_text: He says there are many hearts of stone upon the Asians, naming South Korea, North Korea, China, Taiwan and the Philippines, and that God is calling out those hearts for the people interceding for Asian loved ones.
quote: There's many hearts of stone upon the Asians
falsify_match: A documented wave of conversions across the named Asian countries following this word.
falsify_miss: Addressed to individual listeners about their own relatives, which means any single conversion counts and no absence disproves it.

claim_text: The president has a major decision to make in the next couple of days, walking a valley of decision over whether to infiltrate Cuba as was done in Venezuela, wanting to bring freedom to the Cuban people.
quote: The valley of decision to infiltrate Cuba like you see Venezuela
time_phrase: in the next couple of days
falsify_match: Reporting within a few days of 5 January 2026 that the administration was actively weighing military action against Cuba.
falsify_miss: Days pass with no reported Cuba deliberation. The escape is that a decision weighed in private is never visible, so silence can always be read as the decision being made quietly; a match needs the deliberation to be reported, not inferred later.

claim_text: He says America will not have to touch North Korea, that the Lord will handle it, and that the liberation of Cuba and North Korea is allowed so the gospel can get in where there was a wall.
quote: Cuba, North Korea, you won't have to touch North Korea
falsify_match: North Korea opens or its regime falls without American military action.
falsify_miss: American forces strike North Korea. As of the word there was no sign of either, so the status quo of no action is itself scored as the match, which is the weakness.

claim_text: The Lord will shake Cuba, North Korea and Venezuela, Kim and his sister have their days numbered, and a great revival comes to the land.
quote: Their days are numbered. The Lord's going to shake Cuba
falsify_match: Kim Jong-un and Kim Yo-jong both removed from power, and unrest in Cuba and North Korea.
falsify_miss: Both Kims remain in place. Days are numbered has no end, so this cannot expire; he has been saying it since at least June 2025 and the sister was still in post in August 2026.

claim_text: He is told not to focus on North Korea but on Cuba, a breaking down of communism right in America's backyard, and to watch Cuba in the night.
quote: A breaking down of communism. It's right in your backyard. Watch Cuba
falsify_match: An overnight American operation against Cuba, or the collapse of the Cuban government, in the months after 5 January 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing happens in Cuba. The night framing is the trap: he elsewhere says a successful surprise operation would not be reported, so an absence of news can be claimed either way.

claim_text: Freedom and new growth spring out of Cuba with people cheering in the streets, and he sees the cords attached to Russia being cut and new cords stretched to establish a new government and foundation.
quote: I see a cutting of the cords and stretching forth new cords
falsify_match: Cuba breaks its economic and military ties with Russia and forms a new government aligned with Washington.
falsify_miss: Russian ties to Cuba hold or deepen. Cords and cutting are his own imagery, so a partial cooling of relations would likely be counted as a match.

claim_text: With attention on Venezuela, Ukraine and Cuba, and North Korea on the back shelf, Taiwan comes to the front quickly; China takes the land in three days with a great surrender by the government on the second day.
quote: Three days they'll try to take Taiwan in three days
falsify_match: China invades Taiwan and the Taiwanese government capitulates on the second day, the whole action completed within three days.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or an invasion that runs longer than three days. He has told this both ways, as a two-day fall and here as a three-day operation surrendering on day two; the two versions cannot both be scored as hits, and a drawn-out war fails both.

claim_text: Chinese generals are in meetings making the final decisions on Taiwan as he speaks, asking whether they can get away with it as America did in Venezuela, with three men saying do it and the others saying no, which he calls a vote.
quote: Three men say yes and the others are saying no. It's a vote
falsify_match: Later reporting or a defection account showing a split Chinese military council on Taiwan in early January 2026, with a minority pushing to move.
falsify_miss: No such meeting is ever documented. A vote inside a closed Chinese command is not checkable at the time or likely afterwards, which is what makes the number three safe to give.

claim_text: Russia, Ukraine and Iran are drawn in, and he hears the enemy planning to act on several fronts at the same time so America is stretched too thin.
quote: We can stretch them too thin if we act all at the same time
falsify_match: Simultaneous crises in at least three theatres that visibly overstretch American forces.
falsify_miss: Conflicts stay sequential rather than simultaneous. Stretched too thin is a judgement rather than an event, and commentators say it during every multi-front period, so the base rate is high.

claim_text: Turkey is rising up secretly with Syria, becoming friends in a greater friendship he calls the brotherhood, beating their war drums, with Ezekiel 38 and 39 standing at the door.
quote: Turkey is rising up secretly with Syria. They're becoming friends, a greater friendship
falsify_match: A formal defence or security agreement between Turkey and Syria, announced after 5 January 2026.
falsify_miss: Turkey and Syria stay apart or fall out. Turkish support for the new Syrian government was already public and widely reported before this word, so the priority test fails: he is describing an alignment that already existed.

claim_text: China has infiltrated the land and there are secret cells of Chinese inside America, though he says they are not as large as the cells of the other group he has described.
quote: I see China has infiltrated the land. There's secret cells even of China
falsify_match: Federal charges against a Chinese state network operating cells inside the United States, brought after this word.
falsify_miss: No such network is charged. Chinese espionage prosecutions occur most years, so an arrest would be counted as a match without showing the cells he describes; his own hedge that they are smaller than the others gives room either way.

claim_text: Putin, Xi and Iran are meeting and talking, angered by what happened in Venezuela, because if America can do it there it can be done elsewhere.
quote: they're ticked off about what happened with Venezuela. This is all because of Venezuela
falsify_match: A reported summit or joint statement by Russia, China and Iran responding to the American action in Venezuela.
falsify_miss: No coordinated response appears. Public condemnations from all three were near certain after an American strike, so the base rate is close to one and this predicts almost nothing.

claim_text: He says he can see Kim Jong-un talking in the meetings, and that the subject is Venezuela.
quote: I see Kim talking. It's about Venezuela
falsify_match: North Korean statements or reported consultations about the American action in Venezuela in early January 2026.
falsify_miss: North Korea says nothing about Venezuela. Pyongyang comments on almost every American military action, so a statement would not distinguish a word from a guess.

claim_text: The anger is over the BRICS: they wanted Venezuela for the oil and the financial arrangement, and taking it out weakens the BRICS, which he calls putting a kink in the hose.
quote: It's because of the bricks. You weaken the bricks
falsify_match: Measurable damage to BRICS oil trade or to the bloc cohesion traceable to the loss of Venezuela, such as a stalled member settlement scheme.
falsify_miss: BRICS proceeds unaffected or expands. Weakened is not defined, so any BRICS setback in the years ahead could be claimed, and any BRICS growth explained as the response to the kink.

claim_text: He stops and says he sees a storm coming to America.
quote: I see a storm coming to America
falsify_match: A named national crisis in the months following that he identifies as this storm.
falsify_miss: Nothing distinctive follows. A storm over America with no date, no kind and no place is the least falsifiable form of the recurring storm image, and he has repeated it since 2024.

claim_text: A major shaking comes against Canadian church finances, with a challenge to tax exempt status that he sees succeeding in the courts, and a hate speech challenge to free expression on social platforms.
quote: I see it being successful in the courts
falsify_match: A Canadian court ruling stripping or narrowing charitable tax status for churches, after 5 January 2026.
falsify_miss: No such ruling. Removing charitable status for religious bodies had been raised in a 2024 Canadian finance committee report, so the subject predated the word; the specific part he adds is that the challenge succeeds in court, and that is what must land.

claim_text: Canada has a very fragile economy, but a remnant rises with great glory, signs, wonders and healings that spread and bring healing to the land, and a major revival comes as persecution increases.
quote: Oh Canada, a major revival is coming
falsify_match: A documented and reported revival movement in Canada with mass attendance, in the years after this word.
falsify_miss: Canadian church attendance continues its long decline. He couples it to persecution so that hardship is read as the precursor rather than the disproof, which makes the claim non-expiring.

claim_text: The revival comes out of an olive press, and this concerns Europe also: England, Ireland, France and Germany each an olive press that follows Canada, with suppression of free speech, social platforms and digital IDs, and he says to watch the next three years.
quote: England, an olive press, Ireland, an olive press, France, olive press, Germany olive press
falsify_match: Speech prosecutions or digital ID mandates in all four named countries by January 2029, followed by measurable church growth in them.
falsify_miss: The named countries do not tighten speech law, or the pressure comes without any revival. Britain already had arrests for speech and an announced digital ID plan before this word, so England is not a prediction; Ireland, France and Germany are the parts that carry the risk.

claim_text: He recalls seeing all the oil wells catching fire and a retaliation against the United States in the days ahead because of the oil, and asks whether the troops on the ground were there to secure the oil wells.
quote: I saw all the oil wells catching fire and there was a retaliation
falsify_match: An attack on American soil traceable to Venezuela in the weeks after 4 January 2026.
falsify_miss: No attack. He has carried this since at least December 2025 with no date attached, and elsewhere concedes the oil fields he expected burning had not burned, so the two halves of the vision have already parted company.

claim_text: The United States builds a major military base in Venezuela and occupies the country in the days ahead, with American oil companies going in to fix the broken oil infrastructure.
quote: I saw the United States of America building a major base in Venezuela
falsify_match: Construction of a permanent American military installation in Venezuela, reported after this word.
falsify_miss: No base is built and forces withdraw. Note that the president had already said publicly that American oil companies would go in, and the clip is played here, so only the base and the occupation are his own addition.

claim_text: A new proxy government is set up in Venezuela with the United States governing over it, the country turning red, followed by great revival and economic stability; he compares it to Iraq and says that failed miserably, and repeats that the leader would be like Gaddafi or Saddam and be removed.
quote: a new government set up, a proxy government come in
falsify_match: An American-backed government installed in Caracas that holds, with economic recovery following.
falsify_miss: Venezuela stays under its own government, or an installed government collapses. He hedges the whole thing himself by saying the Iraq version failed miserably and let us see how this goes, which is a claim and an exit in one breath.

claim_text: He notes China held a meeting in Venezuela on 2 January about oil, three hours before the American strikes, and says the Lord and not he said it had to do with the BRICS, so a button must have been pushed.
quote: The Lord, not I, the Lord said it had to do with bricks
falsify_match: Confirmation that the Chinese delegation in Caracas was negotiating oil for a BRICS settlement arrangement.
falsify_miss: The meeting turns out to have been routine. This is him reading a news item back onto an earlier word rather than predicting anything, which is the pattern he warns others about when he says do not pray the news.

claim_text: With America preoccupied, Taiwan falls in three days and China takes Taiwan, and Russia eventually takes all of Ukraine.
quote: Taiwan would fall in three days and I saw Taiwan fall in three days
falsify_match: China takes Taiwan within three days, and Russia takes the whole of Ukraine.
falsify_miss: Neither happens, or either takes longer. This is the three-day form again, given the day after the Venezuela strikes, and it sits against his own two-day telling; the Ukraine half also runs against a front line that had barely moved for over a year.

claim_text: He prays that Iranians are liberated, that Khamenei is removed, that Kim Jong-un and his sister are got rid of, that North Korea and China are saved, and for a major move of God in Taiwan, Europe, South America and Africa.
quote: you'll get rid of Kim Jong-un and his sister
falsify_match: Kim Jong-un and Kim Yo-jong removed from power, and Khamenei out.
falsify_miss: All three remain. Framed as a prayer, so an unanswered prayer is not treated as a failed word, which is how the removal claim survives repeated non-fulfilment since January 2025.

claim_text: Many discoveries will be found in the days ahead, ancient discoveries in Israel that lead back to the word and validate it, which he says the Lord said is for the unbeliever.
quote: Discoveries in Israel. I see Israel. They're going to find discoveries in Israel
falsify_match: A major Israeli archaeological find announced after this word that is presented as corroborating a biblical account.
falsify_miss: Israeli archaeology publishes such finds several times a year, and news coverage routinely frames them as confirming scripture. The base rate is near certainty, so this predicts nothing.

claim_text: He sees something thousands of years old, older than the time of Jesus and going back to the children of Israel in the desert, which is to shake Mecca, and says secrets about the Nephilim come out.
quote: Secrets about Nephilim
falsify_match: A find published after this word that is reported as challenging Islamic claims about Mecca, or as evidence of the Nephilim account.
falsify_miss: No such find. He says himself he does not know what Mecca means here, which leaves the word free to be attached to anything later; a Nephilim discovery has no accepted scientific form, so this cannot be settled either way.

claim_text: He tells viewers not to click away, that the Venezuela word was given to draw people back to Jesus, that they must know him as Lord and Saviour and that they are running out of time.
quote: You must know him as Lord and Savior. You're running out of time
falsify_match: No event is named that could confirm it.
falsify_miss: An appeal rather than a prediction. Running out of time has been said throughout the corpus with no terminal date, so it cannot expire.

claim_text: He sees battleships all around Venezuela and says the Lord told him it is more than drug trafficking: it is a front to cause a pause in the BRICS system, which had offered Venezuela, Cuba and North Korea financial liberty from American sanctions in exchange for oil.
quote: He's trying to cause a front to cause a pause in the bricks system
falsify_match: Officials or documents confirming the Venezuela deployment was aimed at BRICS oil arrangements rather than narcotics.
falsify_miss: The stated counter-narcotics purpose is borne out. The naval deployment was already public and heavily covered before 3 January 2026, so only the motive is his contribution, and a motive is rarely settled by evidence.

claim_text: Putin has had the upper hand making alliances for four years, and he sees Cuba, Venezuela, Egypt, the OPEC nations and China secretly meeting to build the BRICS into a new global currency to combat the dollar.
quote: a new global currency with their their their coalition over here
falsify_match: A launched BRICS settlement currency or platform used by the named members to price oil away from the dollar.
falsify_miss: BRICS never agrees a common currency. Members had publicly discussed de-dollarisation for years before this word and had also publicly ruled out a single currency, so both the subject and the obstacle predate him.

claim_text: Venezuela and Cuba are being promised things, and Putin is not bluffing but creating strong alliances with Kim Jong-un, Cuba and Venezuela for a major war ahead; the Venezuelan leader will be like Saddam.
quote: he's creating alliances, strong alliances for a major war ahead
falsify_match: Formal mutual defence agreements between Russia and Cuba or Venezuela, followed by a wider war involving them.
falsify_miss: The alliances stay rhetorical. Russia already had a signed strategic partnership with North Korea and long-standing ties to Cuba and Venezuela before this word, so the alignment is description rather than prediction; a major war is the part that must land.

claim_text: The Lord showed him the oil derricks and said it is not all about drugs, ten percent, but ninety percent about the oil and the BRICS, and he saw a Gaddafi or Saddam like man overthrown, though he does not know whether by his own government or by the United States.
quote: it's not all about drugs 10% but 90 is about the oil and bricks
falsify_match: Evidence that the operation was principally about oil and BRICS, and the Venezuelan leader removed.
falsify_miss: The removal is the checkable half and he hedges the mechanism himself by saying he does not know who does it, which means either an internal coup or an American action counts. The ninety ten split is a figure that cannot be tested.

claim_text: A revolution and shaking come to Venezuela, trouble in Panama over the canal and drug routes concerning China, the overthrow of a dictator with slick hair, and Putin coming to the aid of Venezuela, which could be a powder keg for greater escalation of war.
quote: I see Putin coming to the aid of Venezuela
falsify_match: Russian military or material support arriving in Venezuela after the American action.
falsify_miss: Russia stays out beyond statements. Moscow was tied down in Ukraine and had not intervened for Venezuela through earlier crises, so the base rate for real Russian intervention is low, which makes this one worth a lot if it lands.

claim_text: He sees TNT barrels with a fuse getting shorter and shorter concerning Venezuela with Russia part of it, says it is about the oil and not the drugs, and hears that they must put a kink in the hose.
quote: The fuse is getting shorter and shorter concerning Venezuela and Russia is a part
falsify_match: Escalation in Venezuela drawing Russia in, with the oil flow to BRICS partners cut.
falsify_miss: The situation settles without Russian involvement. A shortening fuse names no length, so it cannot expire; the kink in the hose is the testable part because oil export figures are published.

claim_text: A darkness comes upon Cuba for the electric grid, with infrastructure problems and cyber attacks by design because they are getting out of line, and he sees gang lords, MS13 and great witchcraft with candles wrapped into it.
quote: this is concerning a darkness upon Cuba for the electric grid
falsify_match: A nationwide Cuban blackout attributed to a cyber attack rather than to plant failure.
falsify_miss: Cuba had already suffered repeated nationwide grid collapses through 2024 and 2025 from its ageing plants, which he acknowledges here by saying it is dated already. So a blackout alone is not a match; the by design part is what would have to be shown.

claim_text: A great river of God's presence and revival spread over Cuba, and he sees an extension cord like an internet cord running deep under the water from Cuba to Russia, which he says is symbolic, recalling the Cuban missile crisis.
quote: It looks like an internet cord going from Cuba to Russia
falsify_match: A Russian communications or intelligence cable to Cuba disclosed after this word.
falsify_miss: Nothing is disclosed. He calls it symbolic himself, which converts a physically checkable object into an image, and Russian signals facilities in Cuba had already been reported in 2023 and 2024.

claim_text: He names great corruption in the Mexican government under Claudia, with keys running from Venezuela to her to Cuba and people and drugs trafficked through tunnels, and repeats that Venezuela will be like Iraq if it keeps going this way, with Russia and Kim stepping in.
quote: Great corruption in the Hispanic government is Claudia
falsify_match: Evidence or indictments tying the Mexican president to cartel money running through Venezuela and Cuba.
falsify_miss: No such evidence. Allegations against Mexican officials over cartel ties are long-standing and were in the news before this word; naming the sitting president is the specific part, and it has produced nothing through August 2026.

claim_text: He says he was up all night praying and delayed the video because the Lord told him not to live stream that night, as things were about to take place, and that they then saw what it was.
quote: I've been up all night praying and I waited to do this video
falsify_match: Nothing to match: no event is described, only the instruction to wait.
falsify_miss: This is a claim of foreknowledge made after the event it points at, told once the news had broken. It is scored as no claim rather than as a hit, since his saying a word landed is not evidence that it did.

claim_text: After praying protection over himself and his family against voodoo and every tongue, he says he was praying for the Iranian people, who are about to have a major revival.
quote: the Iranian people that are about to have a major revival
falsify_match: A reported mass turning to Christianity inside Iran on a scale beyond the existing trend, in the year after January 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable changes. Growth of the Iranian house church has been reported for two decades, so the trend predates the word; about to has no end date, so this cannot expire.

claim_text: Maduro is removed and a new puppet government installed, with the United States setting up camp and eventually a base in Venezuela as it did in Iraq, and Maduro like a Saddam Hussein or a Gaddafi.
quote: the United States would set up camp there like they did in Iraq
falsify_match: A permanent American base in Venezuela and an American-backed government installed in Caracas.
falsify_miss: American forces leave without a base or an installed government. The removal half was already in motion when he said this, so only the base and the puppet government carry weight, and both are matters of public record that can fail cleanly.

claim_text: He recalls seeing Maduro setting all the oil fields in Venezuela on fire, and wonders whether the president acted on his warning, since they captured Maduro and his wife and so may have stopped the burning.
quote: I saw uh Maduro setting all the oil fields on fire in Venezuela
falsify_match: Documented attempts to fire Venezuelan oil installations during the operation.
falsify_miss: The oil fields never burned. He converts the absence into a hit by suggesting his warning prevented it and that the government watches his channel, which is an unfalsifiable form: burning would confirm the word and not burning would confirm the intervention.

claim_text: He says he told them the devil was grooming somebody new, and here he is, the new Obama whom everybody loves because he is a communist, and that a storm is coming to New York.
quote: the devil was grooming somebody new. Here he is. Hello, the new Obama
falsify_match: The New York mayor rising to national prominence as a party figurehead, with the crisis in the city he calls a storm.
falsify_miss: The mayor stays a local figure. The election had already happened when he said this, so identifying the man is not a prediction; the new Obama and the storm are the forward parts, and neither is defined enough to fail on a date.
